## list

List Canned Responses. `GET /canned-responses`

List canned responses visible to the current user.

Returns the user's own responses and all shared responses. Users with canned_responses:settings scope see all responses in the tenant.

```php
$result = $sendseven->cannedResponses()->list();
```

- Scopes: `canned_responses:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |
| `$category` | `?string` | no | Filter by category |
| `$search` | `?string` | no | Search in title, content, and shortcut |

Returns `Page<CannedResponse>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Canned%20Responses/list_canned_responses_api_v1_canned_responses_get)

## create

Create Canned Response. `POST /canned-responses`

Create a new canned response.

By default, responses are personal (visible only to you). Set is_shared=true to make it visible to all team members (requires canned_responses:settings scope).

```php
$result = $sendseven->cannedResponses()->create(title: 'title', content: 'content');
```

- Scopes: `canned_responses:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$title` | `string` | yes | Display title for the canned response |
| `$content` | `string` | yes | The actual response text |
| `$shortcut` | `?string` | no | Keyboard shortcut (e.g., 'greeting'). Stored lowercase. |
| `$category` | `?string` | no | Category for organization (e.g., 'Greetings', 'Support') |
| `$isShared` | `?bool` | no | If true, visible to all team members. If false, only visible to creator. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `CannedResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Canned%20Responses/create_canned_response_api_v1_canned_responses_post)

## getByShortcut

Get By Shortcut. `GET /canned-responses/by-shortcut/{shortcut}`

Get a canned response by its shortcut.

Used for slash command lookups (e.g., /greeting). The shortcut is case-insensitive and the leading slash is optional.

```php
$result = $sendseven->cannedResponses()->getByShortcut(shortcut: 'shortcut');
```

- Scopes: `canned_responses:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$shortcut` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `CannedResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Canned%20Responses/get_by_shortcut_api_v1_canned_responses_by_shortcut__shortcut__get)

## delete

Delete Canned Response. `DELETE /canned-responses/{canned_response_id}`

Delete a canned response.

Users can only delete their own responses. Users with canned_responses:settings scope can delete any response.

```php
$result = $sendseven->cannedResponses()->delete(cannedResponseId: 'canned_response_id');
```

- Scopes: `canned_responses:delete`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$cannedResponseId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `Success`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Canned%20Responses/delete_canned_response_api_v1_canned_responses__canned_response_id__delete)
